name: Tools of the Highborne
summary: Thundris Windweaver sends you from Auberdine to Ameth'Aran. Highborne spirits still haunt the ruins with enchanted relics in their hands, and he wants them taken away.

sections.title: Echoes in the Ruins
sections.body:
Ameth'Aran lies south of Auberdine and east of the coastal highway. Its stone foundations are overgrown. Ten thousand years ago, it was a stronghold of the Highborne, the privileged aristocracy of the ancient night elven empire.

Their unchecked arcane magic helped bring about the Sundering, which shattered the settlement. Yet its inhabitants never truly left. Sentinels patrolling Darkshore report Highborne ghosts in the sunken plazas, still clutching the enchanted tools and trinkets they held in life.

sections.title: Purging the Arcane Past
sections.body: For the kaldorei, arcane magic recalls a danger that nearly destroyed life on Azeroth. Thundris Windweaver fears that the Highborne implements could invite corruption if they remain in ghostly hands. So he sends you to wrest the relics from the restless spirits. He intends to have them destroyed before their tainted magic can fuel another disaster.

faq.q: Where do I find the Highborne relics?
faq.answer: The relics lie in Ameth'Aran, south of Auberdine and east of Darkshore's main path. Wandering spirits carry them through the ruined stone courtyards.

aliases: who gives tools of the highborne
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver is a night elf scholar and elder who lives in Auberdine. He works with the local Sentinels to guard Darkshore against lingering magical taints and ancient curses left by the Sundering.

faq.q: Why does Thundris want these relics destroyed?
aliases: purpose of tools of the highborne
faq.answer: Thundris fears the relics' arcane power could awaken dormant evils. Night elf society rejects arcane magic because reckless Highborne sorcery caused the Great Sundering.

faq.q: What kind of spirits haunt Ameth'Aran?
faq.answer: The spirits are Highborne aristocrats who died during the War of the Ancients. They still cling to their pride, power, and magical artifacts, reenacting their faded lives among the ruins.

faq.q: Why are the Highborne still bound to the ruins?
faq.answer: Thundris does not know why the Highborne remain bound to Ameth'Aran. The Sentinels have told him only that the spirits persist among the ruins and still wield their ancient magical implements.

faq.q: What happens to the relics after you turn them in?
aliases: what does thundris do with relics
faq.answer: Thundris Windweaver takes custody of the relics and plans to dismantle and destroy them. He wants to ensure their dormant arcane taint can never be harnessed or released again.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, the ghosts of Ameth'Aran recall your ancestors' hubris and the Sundering that shattered their empire.
As a mage, you may recognize the relics as rare, pristine examples of Highborne craftsmanship from before the Sundering. Still, the kaldorei seek to destroy them.
As a druid, you help clear corrupted arcane remnants from Ameth'Aran and ease the spiritual wounds disturbing Darkshore's natural tranquility.
As an Alliance member, you help the night elves secure their haunted lands and strengthen the Alliance's presence and solidarity in the ancient forests of northern Kalimdor.
